title: Plasma Spike with Optional Serial Dilution
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Check serial dilution selection
steps.instruction: Verify whether the serial dilution option is enabled in the variable feeds; if it is not selected, skip steps 2‑5.

steps.title: Add diluent to tubes 2‑12
steps.instruction: Add diluent to tubes 2 through 12 (rows A and B) of the 24‑tube rack.

steps.title: Add diluent to tube A1
steps.instruction: Pipette 980 µL of diluent into tube A1 of the 24‑tube rack and mix well.

steps.title: Add stock solution to tube A1
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and manually add 20 µL of stock solution to tube A1 in the 24‑tube rack.

steps.title: Perform serial dilution across A‑B rows
steps.instruction: Create a serial dilution by moving 20 µL from each tube to the next tube in rows A and B (tubes 1‑12). After each transfer, mix the receiving tube before proceeding to the next.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL from tube A1 to tube A2 and mix.
Transfer 20 µL from tube A2 to tube A3 and mix.
Continue this pattern through tube A12 (or B12, depending on rack layout).

steps.title: Add plasma to tubes 13‑24
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of plasma to tubes 13 through 24 (rows C and D) of the 24‑tube rack.

steps.title: Transfer spike to C‑row tubes
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL from each tube in rows A and B to the corresponding tube in row C (e.g., A1 → C1, B1 → C2, etc.).

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL from tube A1 into tube C1.
Pipette 10 µL from tube A2 into tube C2.
Repeat for all tubes in rows A and B.
